column3: ## Successfully upload a file containing an article with references
Setup: Ensure that the publisher account owns a journal for example with Print ISSN "2222-2222" which is not attached to any other journals
Setup: You must be logged in using a pure publisher account
Go to the "Upload Article XML" tab in the "Publisher Area"

Select "Choose file" and select the test resource file "with_references.xml"

Test Resource: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/DOAJ/doaj/feature/3985_references_article_metadata/doajtest/xml_upload_test_package/Crossref/4.4.2/with_references.xml
Choose "Crossref 4.4.2 XML" from "Format of the file" dropdown

column4: A flash message appears at the top of the screen indicating a successful upload
Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "pending"

column3: wait a short amount of time for the job to process, then reload the page (do not re-submit the form data).  If the job remains in "pending", reload the page until the status changes.

column4: Your file is shown in the "History of uploads" with status "successfully processed", and the Note "1 articles imported (1 new, 0 updated)"

column3:
Go to the Table of Contents for the journal (e.g. by going to /toc/2222-2222), go to the Articles tab and open the article "References!"

http://testdoaj.cottagelabs.com//toc/2222-2222

column4: A "References" section is shown on the article page, with 3 references in a numbered list, in the same order as the "citation" elements in the uploaded file
The first reference is the text of the "unstructured_citation" element, and its URL "https://www.doaj.org/" is a link

The second reference is built from the structured citation fields (author, year, article title, journal title, volume, issue, first page and DOI), and its DOI "10.1234/abc" is a link to https://doi.org/10.1234/abc
The third reference is built from the structured citation fields it has (author, year, volume title and ISBN) and contains no links
